name: model_profile_resolve
description: Resolve validated declarative model profiles after workspace preparation.

worktreePath.description: Absolute path to a checked-out repository; if present (or via repoPath), an optional .conductor-code/models.json repository policy layer is merged in.

repoPath.description: Fallback for worktreePath when the latter is not set.

modelsConfig.description: Relative path (inside the worktree) to the repository model policy file, overriding the default .conductor-code/models.json location.

modelPolicy.description: Inline model policy document (or JSON string) to merge on top of the bundled and repository policies.

modelPolicySha256.description: Expected canonical SHA-256 of the inline modelPolicy; resolution fails if it does not match.

modelPolicySource.description: Label recorded for the inline modelPolicy's provenance in the output 'sources' list.

modelProfile.description: Named profile to select from the merged policy's 'profiles' map; defaults to the policy's defaultProfile, then 'standard'.

modelOverrides.description: Per-role overrides merged on top of the selected profile's roles (or a JSON string of the same).

maxTurns.description: Global cap applied (as a minimum) to every role tier's maxTurns.

maxBudgetUsd.description: Global cap applied (as a minimum) to every role tier's maxBudgetUsd.

designModel.description: Legacy single-model override for the 'design' role.

planModel.description: Legacy single-model override for the 'plan' role.

codeModel.description: Legacy single-model override for the 'code' role.

reviewModel.description: Legacy single-model override for the 'review' role.

judgeModel.description: Legacy single-model override for the 'judge' role.

scribeModel.description: Legacy single-model override for the 'scribe' role.

model.description: Legacy generic model override applied to the 'plan' and 'code' roles only.

profile.description: Name of the resolved model profile.

roles.description: Resolved tiers per role (design, plan, code, review, judge, scribe), each an object with a 'tiers' array of {agent, model, maxTurns, maxBudgetUsd, priceKey, availability, fallback}.

reviewLoop.description: Resolved review-loop configuration for the selected profile.

sources.description: Provenance of every policy layer that was merged (bundled defaults, repository policy, inline override), each with source/path/sha256.

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings, e.g. a Codex reviewer falling back to Claude Opus due to unavailability.

canonicalSha256.description: Deterministic SHA-256 of the resolved profile/roles/reviewLoop, used to detect drift between preflight and later re-resolution.
